name: The Last Liquidation
hook: When the Long Toll reads four-of-six, the Brine-Factors call a Liquidation: one crystal, the Vault-Heart, holds a moment so old that no Choir has dared seal it and no Scour has dared shatter it — and now the tide that protected it is leaving. The Factors mean…
setup: Play on a 3 x 3 ft table. Lay 6-10 terrain pieces, then overlay a fixed Tide Track of 6 notches along one table edge where every player can see it. Divide the board into six numbered Tide Bands running parallel to the tideline (Band 1 nearest the dry shore, Band 6 nearest the deep). At the start, Bands 1-2 are Dry (dry side of the terrain overlay up) and Bands 3-6 are Brine-deep (wet side up). Place ONE special crystal model, the Vault-Heart, dead centre in Band 4 (Brine-deep, so it starts auto-protected and Loose). Place two ordinary Loose crystals, one each in Band 3 and Band 5. Set out a single shared Grief pool dish beside the Tide Track with a reserve of tokens. Each player nominates…
deployment: Roll off. The winner picks a long table edge as their Extraction Edge; the loser takes the opposite. (In a 3-4 player game, each player takes a quarter and a corner Extraction Edge.) Players then alternate placing one model at a time within 6 inches of their own edge. NO model may be deployed in Band 4 or in any Brine-deep band adjacent to the Vault-Heart — everyone starts on the dry margins and must wade inward as the tide that guards the prize drains away. Scouts/infiltrators deploy last but may not be placed in a Brine-deep band. The Vault-Heart and the two ordinary crystals are placed during Setup, before any models.
objectives: This is an extraction-and-denial mission, not a body count. Your goal is to fix the Custody fate of the Vault-Heart at the moment the Toll strikes Dry. Three mutually exclusive winning fates exist: EXTRACTED (a Held carrier walks it off your own Extraction Edge — it becomes Coin), DROWNED (a Held carrier spends its whole activation to shove the crystal one band deeper into a still-Brine-deep band and let go — it sinks beyond all custody), or SEALED (a ritual completes it in place in a wet band — Set forever). If the Vault-Heart is still Loose on the table when the Toll strikes Dry in its band it is Exposed to the swarm. Carrying it is an IGNORE tradeoff: a model in base contact may pick it…
twist: THE WATER LEAVES THE TABLE. At the start of every round the Tide marker advances one mandatory, unskippable notch and ALL of one numbered Band flips from Brine-deep to Dry via the double-sided overlay: Round 2 flips Band 3, Round 3 flips Band 4 (the Vault-Heart's home — the hinge of the game),…
